study_status: Reproduction of the fixed exploratory follow-up; original test exposure remains disclosed
motivation: User requested a newer accessible advanced model and an end-to-end comparison against DINOv2
primary_question: Under fixed low-resource adaptation settings, how does partial SigLIP2 compare with partial DINOv2 on the published Beans test split?
secondary_questions: Within-backbone effect of adapting final two blocks
Cost, run variability, class errors, synthetic sensitivity and overfitting

siglip2.readout: Pretrained attention-pooled image representation,768dim; vision tower only

settings.augmentation: Matched seed/epoch/image randomness: horizontal and vertical flips with probability 0.5; rotation uniform from -15 to +15 degrees; native-mean fill
settings.partial_policy: Final two transformer blocks, final normalization and new linear classifier; SigLIP pretrained MAP pooling head stays frozen
settings.head_initialization: Paired within each backbone; dimensions differ across backbones
settings.selection: Highest validation macro-F1; lower loss on exact tie; earlier epoch; patience resets only on strict F1 increase

execution.pilot: Both arms: full training epoch, gradient and freeze checks, checkpoint round trip; no test inference
execution.evaluation: All 12 training runs finish; create per-backbone checkpoint locks; then evaluate each selected checkpoint on test
execution.failure_policy: Diagnose implementation/access/hardware failures; record any protocol amendment before rerunning; do not silently change settings based on test results

analysis.seed_summary: Mean and sample standard deviation over three paired seeds; show every seed

bootstrap.scope: Seed-17 partial SigLIP2 minus DINOv2; descriptive, conditional on this previously evaluated small test set

analysis.overfitting: Evaluate all unchanged selected checkpoints on clean training and validation data; reuse recorded test results; inspect all histories

interpretation_limits: Prior test exposure makes this expanded study exploratory, not fresh confirmatory evidence.
Backbone sizes, pretrained data, representation pooling and native preprocessing differ; this does not isolate age or pretraining objective.
Same learning rates/adaptation depth are a fixed resource protocol, not separately optimized best performance for each model.
No known plant/farm IDs, no independent external dataset, unknown pretraining overlap.
Recent competitive model family does not establish best performance in October2026 or a state-of-the-art Beans result.
